q_en: How do I send you the footage?
a_id: Lewat Google Drive, Dropbox, atau WeTransfer. Untuk proyek di Bali, hard disk juga bisa diantar langsung.
a_en: Through Google Drive, Dropbox or WeTransfer. For projects in Bali, you can also drop off a hard drive.

q_id: Berapa kali saya bisa minta revisi?
q_en: How many revisions do I get?
a_id: Tergantung paket, biasanya dua kali. Revisi tambahan dihitung per jam kerja.
a_en: It depends on the package, usually two rounds. Extra revisions are billed by the hour.

q_id: Apakah musiknya aman dari klaim hak cipta?
q_en: Is the music safe from copyright claims?
a_id: Saya memakai musik berlisensi dari library berbayar, atau musik yang kamu sediakan sendiri.
a_en: I use licensed tracks from a paid music library, or music you supply yourself.

a_id: Bisa. Sebagian besar klien saya di luar Bali, dan semua review dilakukan online.
a_en: Yes. Most of my clients are outside Bali, and every review happens online.

a_en: 50% up front, and the balance before the master files are delivered.
